learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has not produced a fresh matrix since 2026-06-30 19:21Z — SAFE MODE has now persisted through 07-01, 07-02, and 07-03 (holiday). The workflow is fired manually (workflow_dispatch) and is not being triggered before sessions. Until it is run, no signal-based action is possible and the site's quant matrix is a ~4-day-old snapshot. This is the standing top operational fix.

NVDA wicked to $189.80 intraday on 06-29 — below its $190.04 manual stop — yet was never sold; the fractional between-session monitor did not fire on the brief wick (it reads main; recent writes went to feature branches). A tight 5% stop on a high-vol name plus interval-based fractional monitoring can miss a fast intraday wick. Confirms the ATR-floor logic (whole-share names get broker trailing stops; fractional names are only as good as the monitor's cadence and branch).

The 06-30 composites read NEUTRAL/BEARISH into a rip, then the tape reversed hard on 07-02 (SOXX -5.5%, QQQ -1.7%, INTC -13.7% over two sessions). The lagging MACD-driven composite that looked 'too bearish' at the top was directionally early on the pullback. In fast reversals the composite confirms late in BOTH directions — treat a stale bullish tape with caution.

First T+5 vs-QQQ grades: ARKK +5.56% excess (win), INTC -2.98%, NVDA -2.08% (losses). Beta dominated — QQQ itself was roughly flat-to-down over the windows, so the excess figures are cleaner reads than absolute returns. 1 of 4 wins (25%); sample is tiny and pre-engine, so it sets a baseline, not a verdict.

After the 07-02 pullback the book sits at 25.7/50.0/23.9 LAB/CORE/DRIP — CORE dead-on target, LAB still over its 20% cap, DRIP -6.1pp under. The pullback nudged LAB down toward its cap without any trim (LAB fell more than CORE), illustrating §17.3: overweight tiers self-correct via price + base growth, not forced selling.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null still persist for every DRIP name, so the §15.3 screen (streak>=5, payout<80%) stays unverifiable. Covered-call JEPI/JEPQ (payout N/A by rule) can seed on yield; SCHD/DGRO/VIG/VYM wait on the streak/payout fix.
